text: Y'all like EMP, so what y'all sayin'? Let's East Coast! West Coast! Midwest! Dirty! A turd used to be friends that had spades. Smack a cap with a four til they backspin. If cats think seven, eat em, they wrong. My crib's back in fifth gear, we can spar if you want. Star some, sit with a plan, just expanding the brand. And if you think I'm talkin' to you, I probably am. Don't let them lames get your life changed. Acknowledge the fam, we L-O-S-T. Cowardly man, understand?
